blocks.text: CHICAGO — Jalen Brunson had 38 points and seven assists, and the New York Knicks beat the Chicago Bulls 133-127 in the NBA on Wednesday night for their second straight win. Karl-Anthony Towns had 19 points and 13 rebounds for New York, which beat the Detroit Pistons 111-97 on Tuesday night after dropping its first three games of the season. OG Anunoby scored 23 points, Jordan Clarkson had 18 and Landry Shamet finished with 14.
